packageRules.description: The Pages actions only run on main, so no branch build exercises a major of theirs before it merges.
The renovate bump moves the version test/test_renovate_presets.mjs runs against; in its own PR, a release that breaks the script holds back nothing else.
TypeScript 7 removed tsconfig 'baseUrl', which @docusaurus/tsconfig still sets, so `npm run typecheck` fails. Unhold once Docusaurus ships a TS7-compatible tsconfig.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Most security alerts here are transitive dependencies of the docs site, which no package.json bump reaches. A weekly lockfile refresh pulls their fixed versions within the existing ranges.
